name: Backpack Dock

pages.text: Place the dock and interact with its frame while holding a backpack, then open the docked pack.

pages.title: Placing
pages.text: Craft the dock through JEI and place it. Hold a backpack and interact with the frame area to dock it. If no backpack is present, the menu explains that it is missing.

pages.title: Opening and removing
pages.text: Interacting with the docked pack opens its native storage. The frame area handles insertion and removal separately. Contents belong to the backpack itself; the dock is not an augment-purchase station.

pages.title: Where to configure
pages.text: Unlocks and augment configuration use the active Backpacked menus. The retired JEM Augment Bay station is not required for this dock or for token use.
